# Georgia Gold Buyers

> Family-owned precious-metals and jewelry buyer in Georgia since 2012, with two locations: Valdosta (South Georgia / North Florida) and McDonough (Henry County / South Metro Atlanta). We buy gold, silver, platinum, coins, bullion, jewelry, diamonds, luxury watches, and designer handbags. Every item is tested in front of the customer (including XRF metal analysis), weighed on a certified scale, and priced from the live spot market. Payment is cash on the spot (check available for large transactions). Free appraisals, no obligation, no minimum.

## Locations

Serves McDonough, Henry County, Stockbridge, Hampton, Locust Grove, and South Metro Atlanta. Page: https://georgiagoldbuying.com/mcdonough.html
- Email: sell@georgiagoldbuying.com. Walk-ins welcome during business hours; booking ahead is recommended.
- To sell: bring a valid government-issued photo ID (required by Georgia law); sellers must be 18+. We buy only — we do not offer pawn loans.

## How it works

1. Bring your items (or request a free quote online first).
2. We test purity in front of you (XRF analyzer and acid testing) and weigh on a certified scale.
3. We show you the math: weight × purity × current spot price, and make you an offer.
4. Accept and get paid on the spot, or walk away — no pressure, no fee.

## What we buy

- Gold: jewelry (10k, 14k, 18k, 22k, 24k), broken or scrap gold, dental gold, gold coins and bars — https://georgiagoldbuying.com/services.html
- Silver: sterling flatware and jewelry, silver coins, bars and rounds
- Platinum and palladium jewelry and bullion
- Coins and bullion (American Eagles, Krugerrands, Maple Leafs, US silver coins)
- Diamonds and fine/designer jewelry
- Luxury watches (Rolex, Omega, Cartier, and other brands)
- Designer handbags and accessories
- Estate and inherited collections — https://georgiagoldbuying.com/estate-sales.html
